headline: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation: 89 measures now on the platform, naming 10 sectors
body: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation is now on the platform. Its 89 measures have been read one provision at a time. The act names 10 sectors in its own text — most often Retail, on 46 measures — and reaches 3 more through supply chains, dependencies on other acts, or procurement. This act is adopted. It is law, not a proposal.

act_label: CBAM extension — downstream goods and anti-circumvention
headline: CBAM extension — downstream goods and anti-circumvention: 61 measures now on the platform, naming 6 sectors
body: CBAM extension — downstream goods and anti-circumvention is now on the platform. Its 61 measures have been read one provision at a time. The act names 6 sectors in its own text — most often Steel, on 41 measures — and reaches 2 more through supply chains, dependencies on other acts, or procurement. The proposal COM(2025) 989, under procedure 2025/0419(COD), would change an act already in force. What it adds is not law yet; the act it changes is.

headline: EU ETS revision: 51 measures now on the platform, naming 8 sectors
body: EU ETS revision is now on the platform. Its 51 measures have been read one provision at a time. The act names 8 sectors in its own text — most often Aviation, on 10 measures — and reaches 3 more through supply chains, dependencies on other acts, or procurement. This is a Commission proposal, COM(2026) 616, under procedure 2026/0212(COD). It is not law yet, and it can change before it is.
